Amateur player runs 17 in three cushion

What would it be like as an amateur player to get a 17 run ? It is impossible, but here is how you can enjoy the feeling:

  1. Play on a 6ft table with full size UMB balls that feel the size of melons.
  2. Next you need a steadfast cue action that hits exactly as you intended.
  3. Finally a judicious referee who will call it a hit so long as you were there or there abouts.
